🏷️ Private Sector

🏢 Company: Hararghe Health Research Collaboration

💼 Positions:
1. Accountant
   📍 Location: Addis Ababa
   🎓 Requirements:
   - Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field
   - Professional accounting certification or progress toward one (advantage)
   - Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in accounting or financial management
   - Experience in financial reporting, bank reconciliation, payroll, tax and statutory compliance, and budget monitoring
   - Experience in NGOs, CSOs, research institutions, or donor‑funded projects (highly desirable)
   - Experience in grant accounting and donor financial reporting (advantage)
   - Practical experience using accounting software, preferably QuickBooks or similar systems
   - Good knowledge of Ethiopian tax, pension, and financial requirements
   - Strong Microsoft Excel skills
   - Experience managing finances for multiple projects or grants
   - Experience working with international donors and institutional partners
   - Experience establishing or strengthening financial systems and internal controls
   - Knowledge of accounting standards and good financial management practices
   - Experience supporting external audits and donor financial reviews

📅 Deadline: October 5th, 2026
📞 Contact: hhrc@hararghe.org
📝 Application Method: Submit application via email to hhrc@hararghe.org
🔗 Link: https://elelanajobs.com/2026/09/04/hararghe-health-research-collaboration/

🏷️ Fresh Graduate | Banking & Finance

🏢 Company: Dashen Bank SC  

💼 Positions:  
1. Customer Service Officer- Maker  
   📍 Location: Bahir Dar District  
   🎓 Requirements:  
   - Bachelor Degree in a business related field (e.g., Marketing Management, Accounting, Management, Economics, Business Administration, Information Technology or equivalent)  
   - CGPA 2.5 and above  
   - Zero years of experience  
   - Age not more than 25 years (for external applicants)  
   - Fresh graduates from 2025/2026 G.C only  
   - Degree certificate, Grade 8th and 12th certificates, updated CV and application letter  
   - Good command of Microsoft Office and core banking system  
   - Strong communication, analytical, and customer relationship skills  

📅 Deadline: September 10, 2026  

📝 Application Method: Apply via source job page  
🔗 Link: https://career55.sapsf.eu/sfcareer/jobreqcareer?jobId=2306&company=dashenbank
